name: fantasy

stages.name: 星降る夜
stages.description: 星空の下で旅が始まる
stages.prompt: high quality anime fantasy illustration, vast starry sky above an ancient kingdom, silver moonlight, intricate scenery

stages.name: 旅立ち
stages.description: 未知の世界へ踏み出す
stages.prompt: anime cinematic illustration, young adventurer on a winding path through an enchanted landscape, flowing cloak, epic scale

stages.name: 祈りの聖域
stages.description: 願いが静かに力を宿す
stages.prompt: anime fantasy illustration, sacred crystal sanctuary, hands clasped in prayer, gentle radiant magic, delicate details

stages.name: 奇跡の覚醒
stages.description: 秘められた力が目覚める
stages.prompt: epic anime fantasy illustration, magical transformation, luminous runes and swirling stardust, dramatic light

stages.name: 希望の夜明け
stages.description: 旅の先に新しい世界が広がる
stages.prompt: cinematic anime fantasy landscape, golden sunrise over mountains and castle, hopeful grand finale

character.description: The same young adult man anime protagonist in every scene: long ash-blond hair tied with a leather clasp, bright blue eyes, with a clearly recognizable face and stable adult proportions. They are a wandering spell-scribe mapping forgotten roads and lost magic. Signature clothing: a weathered blue travel cloak over a cream tunic, rune-stitched bracers, and sturdy boots. Defining personal object: a hand-bound grimoire with a single glowing blue rune. Keep the same facial structure, hairstyle, hair and eye colors, body proportions, clothing silhouette, and personal object throughout the entire music video.
consistency_rules: Use one fixed protagonist identity throughout this theme's entire music video.
Preserve the same recognizable face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, age impression, and body proportions.
Keep the signature outfit silhouette, key materials, colors, and defining personal object unchanged.
Do not replace the protagonist or add another lead unless the lyrics explicitly call for one.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in ancient castle, enchanted forest, floating ruins; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with royal blue, moon silver, gold, violet; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by epic wide shot, low angle hero shot, close-up portrait; clear subject separation and intentional negative space

camera_guidance.principle: vary shot scale and viewpoint to support the scene; avoid repeating identical framing in consecutive scenes
